hero_description.en: Canadian census data offers precise insights for business decisions, but its complexity can be a hurdle. The MTM Census Tool is a user-friendly interactive dashboard that simplifies census data analysis, providing geography-based demographic information sourced directly from Statistics Canada.

highlights_stat_1_description.en: Analyze audiences across 70,000+ Geographic Areas, by region, city, or postal area to pinpoint where media and tech trends emerge.

highlights_stat_2_description.en: Segment by 2,000+ Demographic Variables like age, gender, income, or language to reveal who’s driving adoption and change.

tool_1_subtitle.en: Understand any region at a glance

tool_1_description.en: Population, age, income, language, immigration, indigenous identity: Any Canadian geography in seconds.

tool_1_benefit_1_des.en: Generate instant "Community Portraits" for any Canadian geography.

tool_1_benefit_2_des.en: Analyze population, age, income, and language in seconds.

tool_1_benefit_3_des.en: Easily export data tables for quick analysis and sharing.

stat_callout_1_description.en: In Toronto, 63% of women aged 18-34 make less than $40,000/year

tool_2_description.en: Find exactly who you are looking for by combining up to three distinct characteristics simultaneously. Layer specific demographic filters to surface the precise communities your work is about and visualize their distribution across the map

tool_2_benefit_1_des.en: Find populations with the exact combination of characteristics you require.

tool_2_benefit_2_des.en: Use interactive maps to visualize exactly where your target population lives

tool_2_benefit_3_des.en: Access characteristic distributions and ranked geographies for your selected segments.

tool_3_description.en: Eliminate the guesswork by ranking every geography in Canada against your specific business KPIs. Instantly identify geographies of interest.

tool_3_benefit_1_des.en: Rank geographies based on any specific Census characteristic.

tool_3_benefit_2_des.en: Rank markets by counts, percentages, medians, or averages.

tool_3_benefit_3_des.en: Precision-target regions by filtering out irrelevant population sizes.

tool_4_description.en: Analyze any region through granular characteristic distributions. Move beyond surface-level statistics to evaluate the unique profiles of individuals, families, and households.

tool_4_benefit_1_des.en: View distributions of any characteristic in any Canadian geography.

tool_4_benefit_2_des.en: Access data on individuals, families, dwellings, and household types.

tool_4_benefit_3_des.en: Explore averages and medians alongside distributions for thorough location understanding.

stat_callout_2_description.en: of the labour force in Saskatchewan work in the primary sector (Sector 11: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting, and Sector 21: Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction), more than any other province

tool_5_description.en: Contextualize your regional data by contrasting local markets against provincial or national standards. Identify demographic gaps and outliers to to better understand you target market.

tool_5_benefit_1_des.en: Compare a market against similar regions or national benchmarks.

tool_5_benefit_2_des.en: Contrast characteristic distributions across different geographies using intuitive charts.

tool_5_benefit_3_des.en: Identify and understand demographic differences between specific territories.

tool_6_subtitle.en: Data-driven scoring tailored to your strategy

tool_6_description.en: Take control of your market analysis with advanced, multi-factor weighted modeling. Score and rank potential locations based on your custom persona clusters to find the best opportunities for your brand.

tool_6_benefit_1_des.en: Align rankings to your strategy using weighted modeling and custom personas.

tool_6_benefit_2_des.en: Ensure only geographies meeting your specific business thresholds are considered.

tool_6_benefit_3_des.en: Access millions of characteristic combinations possible across four distinct dimensions.
